title: Write developer contributing guide
description:
Write CONTRIBUTING.md: how to set up the dev environment, how to run tests, how to run a local two-node test (transit + reader), branch naming, PR process, commit message format (conventional commits), and how to run the interop test suite. Artifact: CONTRIBUTING.md.

Acceptance criteria: a new contributor can open a PR that passes CI from this guide alone; local two-node test is runnable in under 5 minutes
